model: Simple Glide Dual 750w (Max 1500w, Dual Battery, Total 30ah)
description:
The Simple Glide E-Trike has always been about effortless comfort and stability—and now, it’s been reimagined with even more performance, convenience, and rider-friendly features. With dual 750W hub motors and dual 48V 15Ah batteries, this recumbent fat tire e-trike delivers unmatched power, range, and reliability. Add in an adjustable seat, rear suspension, cargo basket, and optional canopy, and you’ve got the ultimate ride for seniors, adventurers, and anyone seeking safe, cushioned, and versatile electric mobility.

Dual Motors for All-Terrain Confidence

The new Simple Glide comes equipped with two powerful 750W motors—one in the front hub and one in the rear. This dual-motor system provides added traction, balance, and hill-climbing ability, giving you the confidence to handle pavement, dirt paths, gravel trails, and more. No matter the terrain, you’ll feel stable, supported, and in control.

Dual Batteries = Extended Range

Say goodbye to range anxiety. With two 48V 15Ah batteries, you’ll enjoy longer rides without worrying about running out of power. Depending on terrain, assist level, and rider weight, you can achieve extended mileage—perfect for exploring farther, running errands, or simply riding for pleasure all day long.

Adjustable Seat with Cushioned Support

Comfort has always been a hallmark of the Simple Glide, and now it’s even better. The seat can be raised or lowered, allowing riders of different heights and abilities to find their perfect fit. Combined with its plush backrest, armrests, and ergonomic design, you’ll feel secure and supported mile after mile.

Rear Suspension for a Smoother Ride

Bumps, cracks, and vibrations are no match for the new rear suspension system. It absorbs shocks and smooths out uneven terrain, making every ride more comfortable and joint-friendly—especially important for seniors or riders managing mobility challenges.

Cargo-Ready with Rear Basket

Whether you’re picking up groceries, carrying personal items, or packing a picnic, the rear basket now comes standard. It provides ample storage so you can bring everything you need, making this e-trike as practical as it is comfortable.

Optional Canopy Protection

Take your comfort to the next level with the optional canopy. Shield yourself from direct sun on hot days or stay dry during light rain showers. With this added accessory, you can ride more often, in more conditions, without worry.

Why Choose the New Simple Glide Dual-Motor E-Trike?

Dual 750W motors for all-terrain performance.

Dual 48V 15Ah batteries for longer range.

Adjustable seat for customizable comfort.

Rear suspension for a cushioned ride.

Rear cargo basket included standard.

Optional canopy for sun and rain protection.

Fat tires + recumbent design for ultimate stability.

The Simple Glide Dual-Motor E-Trike takes everything riders love about the original and elevates it into a new class of performance and comfort. For seniors, mobility-focused riders, and anyone who values safety, stability, and freedom—this is the most complete e-trike experience available today.
